zh.title: 使用說明
zh.intro: 開始前，先確認播放模式、設定與連接設備。

sections.title: 開始使用
sections.body: 選擇聆聽或外接 Pad 模式，確認設定與時間後再開始。聆聽時請從低音量調整。

sections.title: 外接 Pad
sections.body: 目前為 iCare Pad 設備測試版，相容性尚未驗證。連接前請先停止播放，依設備原廠說明操作；勿將手機輸出直接接到人體電極。

sections.title: 播放與中斷
sections.body: 使用 Pad 時請保持頁面在前景。離開頁面或音訊中斷後，確認設備狀態，再手動繼續播放。

sections.title: 紀錄與備份
sections.body: 使用紀錄保存在目前裝置的瀏覽器，清除瀏覽資料可能使紀錄遺失。請定期匯出加密備份並妥善保管密碼；密碼遺失後無法復原備份。

sections.title: 使用範圍
sections.body: 畫面上的音量不代表治療劑量。本工具不能代替醫療評估；如需治療，請與醫療專業人員討論。

en.title: User guide
en.intro: Before starting, check the playback mode, settings, and connected equipment.

sections.title: Getting started
sections.body: Choose listening or external Pad mode, then check the settings and duration before starting. Begin listening at a low volume.

sections.title: External Pad
sections.body: The iCare Pad mode is an equipment test version; compatibility has not been verified. Stop playback before connecting and follow the manufacturer's instructions. Never connect phone output directly to electrodes on the body.

sections.title: Playback and interruptions
sections.body: Keep this page in the foreground when using the Pad. After leaving the page or an audio interruption, check the equipment before manually resuming playback.

sections.title: Records and backups
sections.body: Usage records stay in the browser on this device and may be lost if browsing data is cleared. Export encrypted backups regularly and keep the password safe. A backup cannot be recovered if its password is lost.

sections.title: Scope of use
sections.body: The displayed volume is not a treatment dose. This tool does not replace medical assessment. Discuss treatment needs with a healthcare professional.
